description: Register a file or folder you created only to reach a state (a harness page rendering one component, a seed script, a demo project cloned under the system temp directory). capture_finish deletes it so the repo and machine are left clean. It must be inside the repo or a folder of its own under the system temp directory, and made during this capture: anything git tracks, the developer's uncommitted changes, and anything older than the capture are refused.
name: capture_temp_file
title: Register a temporary file
